name: naver_order_first_infinity
sql: SELECT payload->>'paymentDate' AS date FROM public.order_items WHERE payload->>'storeId'='5ba1d3cf-7aee-4cd1-aecd-d44352f665dd' AND payload->>'paymentDate' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY payload->>'paymentDate' ASC LIMIT 1

name: naver_order_last_infinity
sql: SELECT payload->>'paymentDate' AS date FROM public.order_items WHERE payload->>'storeId'='5ba1d3cf-7aee-4cd1-aecd-d44352f665dd' AND payload->>'paymentDate' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY payload->>'paymentDate' DESC LIMIT 1

sql: SELECT payload->>'paymentDate' AS date FROM public.order_items WHERE payload->>'storeId'='78f8cb08-ffe3-481a-94d7-be87ae93ed79' AND payload->>'paymentDate' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY payload->>'paymentDate' ASC LIMIT 1

name: naver_order_last_patima

name: naver_cost_settings_corrected
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId' AS unit_id,payload->>'effectiveFrom' AS effective_from,payload->>'effectiveTo' AS effective_to,payload->>'unitCost' AS unit_cost,payload->>'otherCost' AS other_cost,payload->>'feeRate' AS fee_rate,payload->>'isActive' AS active FROM public.sales_unit_cost_settings ORDER BY payload->>'storeId',payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId',payload->>'effectiveFrom' LIMIT 150

name: naver_cost_snapshots
sql: SELECT id,payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'effectiveFrom' AS effective_from FROM public.sales_unit_cost_snapshots ORDER BY payload->>'storeId',payload->>'effectiveFrom' LIMIT 100

name: naver_cost_entries
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'snapshotId' AS snapshot_id,payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId' AS unit_id,payload->>'unitCost' AS unit_cost,payload->>'otherCost' AS other_cost,payload->>'feeRate' AS fee_rate FROM public.sales_unit_cost_snapshot_entries ORDER BY payload->>'storeId',payload->>'snapshotId',payload->>'canonicalSalesUnitId' LIMIT 300

name: google_campaign_names
sql: SELECT metric_date::text,campaign_name,cost_micros::text FROM meta_ads.google_campaign_daily_costs WHERE is_current AND metric_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' ORDER BY metric_date,campaign_name

name: cafe24_cost_presence
sql: SELECT l.connection_id,l.order_date::text,l.source::text,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.product_id IS NULL) AS unmapped,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.product_id IS NOT NULL AND cr.id IS NULL) AS missing_cost FROM meta_ads.cafe24_order_lines l LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.id FROM meta_ads.product_cost_rules r WHERE r.product_id=l.product_id AND r.effective_from<=l.order_date AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to>=l.order_date) ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC,r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) cr ON true WHERE l.is_current AND l.validation_status::text<>'ERROR' AND l.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

name: coupang_cost_presence
sql: SELECT l.sale_date::text,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.coupang_product_id IS NULL) AS unmapped,count(*) FILTER(WHERE l.coupang_product_id IS NOT NULL AND cr.id IS NULL) AS missing_cost,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cr.id IS NOT NULL AND cr.hanaro_shipping_fee_krw IS NULL) AS growth_shipping_null,count(*) FILTER(WHERE fee.id IS NULL) AS global_fee_missing FROM meta_ads.coupang_sale_lines l LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT r.* FROM meta_ads.coupang_cost_rules r WHERE r.coupang_product_id=l.coupang_product_id AND r.effective_from<=l.sale_date AND(r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to>=l.sale_date) ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC,r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1)cr ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT r.id FROM meta_ads.coupang_sales_fee_rules r WHERE r.effective_from<=l.sale_date AND(r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to>=l.sale_date) ORDER BY r.effective_from DESC LIMIT 1)fee ON true WHERE l.is_current AND l.validation_status::text<>'ERROR' AND l.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

name: exchange_rates_recent
sql: SELECT rate_date::text,currency,rate::text FROM meta_ads.exchange_rates WHERE rate_date BETWEEN '2026-10-20' AND '2026-10-26' ORDER BY rate_date

name: signature_keys
sql: SELECT jsonb_object_keys(payload) AS key FROM (SELECT payload FROM public.order_source_signatures LIMIT 1) s

name: naver_common_recent
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'date' AS date,payload->>'amount' AS amount FROM public.daily_fake_purchases WHERE payload->>'date'>='2026-10-20' AND payload->>'date'<'2026-10-27' ORDER BY 1,2
